description.excerpt: Display and form view mode configuration dependencies are recalculated to ensure all dependencies are recorded. View modes implement widget plugins which may have module dependencies. Previously, if a view mode implemented the same widget multiple times with different dependencies, then only one of those dependencies would be saved in the configuration's dependency list. This could cause situations where a module could be uninstalled without warning that a configuration depended on it. Site owners must ensure that updates are executed after upgrading to get the recalculated dependencies.

symbols.semantics: A change record names symbols. It does not, in this contract, assert their lifecycle; that comes from the deprecation index.
